name: glitch-root
description: Glitch - Autonomous AI DevOps Console with Local SQLite Backend

scripts.test: node --test services/daemon/test/daemon.test.mjs && npm --prefix packages/web run build
scripts.db:status: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4780/api/db/status || node -e 'import("./services/daemon/src/db.mjs").then(m => { const { db, dbPath } = m.initDatabase(); console.log("DB:", dbPath); console.log("Tables:", db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\"").all()); db.close(); })'
scripts.db:init: node -e 'import("./services/daemon/src/db.mjs").then(m => { const { dbPath } = m.initDatabase(); console.log("✔ SQLite database initialized at:", dbPath); })'
